title: Endpoint ACCESS-BARRIER state persistence/timescale across a window ladder and the class-conditional validity horizon of a static endpoint denylist
question: On the frozen 57-endpoint credential-free HTTP GET pool (parent EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068, which inherited it verbatim from EXP-PHYSICS-37973239386; NOT extended because the pre-freeze attainability certificate is satisfied inside the frozen 57), is an endpoint's intrinsic ACCESS-BARRIER state STATIONARY across separated observation windows -- measured as the persistence of each intrinsic class {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR} versus the transient/recovering rate-driven class {RATE_LIMIT_429} and the ordinary classes {CLEAN, UNAVAILABLE_403, OTHER_NONBARRIER} -- and does a static endpoint-level denylist built from an anchor window at T0 retain predictive validity at T0+delta (false-accept = a denylisted endpoint recovers; false-reject = a previously CLEAN endpoint newly blocks), so that the validity horizon and the class-conditional re-probe interval of the product's dead-end policy are ESTIMABLE rather than assumed? The unit of study is endpoint access-state persistence/timescale, NOT next-request barrier classification (bounded by EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068) and NOT staleness of inherited content (C-FRESHNESS) or Runtime drift controls. The temporal/window axis is measured; the source-vantage axis is a declared single-vantage scope boundary (one stdlib HTTP egress). The primary stationarity decision is made on endpoint-identity information (STATIONARITY_SKILL) and intrinsic-class persistence; the coarse pooled-denylist horizon is a reported product quantity that does not, by itself, overwrite the stationarity decision (see decision_rule.branch_precedence).

hypothesis.H1_stationary: Endpoint ambient access-barrier state is stationary on the tested timescale: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref) is significant (>= 0.05 nats/endpoint, endpoint-permutation p < 0.05, endpoint-clustered CI lower > 0; STAT_SIG_SIGONLY), each present intrinsic class {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR} has CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.90 (INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT), no rate-driven transient instability is observed (NOT RATE_TRANSIENT), there is no state-change evidence, and the pooled static denylist consequently keeps DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT and DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT <= 0.10 through the full nominal ladder (DENYLIST_HORIZON = 1800 s, an implied reported consequence rather than a separate gate).
hypothesis.H2_nonstationary: Endpoint ambient access-barrier state is NOT stationary on the tested timescale: there is POSITIVE evidence of state change within the ladder -- at least one present intrinsic class {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR} fails CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.90 (INTRINSIC_BREAK), or, when no intrinsic class is present at T0, ambient transitions/recoveries or a denylist false-accept/false-reject at the 1800 s reference occur (STATE_CHANGE_EVIDENCE) -- so a pooled static denylist has no usable validity horizon beyond immediate re-observation. A merely non-significant stationarity test with NO positive change evidence is NOT S0; it is SIN_INCONCLUSIVE (an underpowered/ambiguous negative is not a scientific negative).
hypothesis.H2b_class_conditional: A single pooled static denylist is the wrong object: intrinsic non-rate barriers (BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR) are persistent (CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.90) while rate-driven barriers (RATE_LIMIT_429, observed through the frozen stress stratum and the ambient ladder) recover or appear transiently within the ladder, so validity is class-conditional and the re-probe interval must differ by class.
hypothesis.H0_null: Memoryless/exchangeable endpoints: the lag state is independent of the anchor state, so STATIONARITY_SKILL is ~0 under the B_EXCHANGE permutation null and a static denylist is no better than a constant usable-endpoint prior.
hypothesis.relation_to_claim: H1/H2/H2b are orthogonal falsifiable programs on the C-WEB-DYNAMICS next_gate axis 'timescales'. H2/H2b bound (do not reject) a pooled static-denylist prior on this pool/window; no hypothesis advances C-WEB-DYNAMICS above HYPOTHESIS.

falsifier: TWO-SIDED AND BOTH DIRECTIONS FROZEN-REACHABLE (see prereg.md 'Attainability certificate' and freeze_eligibility.decision_rule_reachability). Primary quantities: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref=1800s) = plug-in binary mutual information I(B_0 ; B_delta) in nats per endpoint over the ambient barrier indicator, with a B_EXCHANGE GLOBAL endpoint-permutation null (10000 uniform shuffles of the lag vector across all 57 endpoints; seed 38074818597) and an endpoint-clustered bootstrap 95% CI (cluster = registrable domain defined in measurement_validity.uncertainty_integrity; 10000 resamples, seed 38074818597); DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT(delta) = fraction of T0 ambient-barrier endpoints that are non-barrier at delta; DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT(delta) = fraction of T0 ambient-nonbarrier endpoints that are barrier at delta; DENYLIST_HORIZON = largest ladder delta delta_k such that FA and FR pass at EVERY lag up to and including delta_k (a contiguous valid prefix), else 0. Frozen thresholds: tau_FA = tau_FR = 0.10; alpha = 0.05; delta_SKILL = 0.05 nats; pc_power_min = 0.80; nc_false_positive_max = 0.05; intrinsic_persistence_min = 0.90. Let STAT_SIG_SIGONLY = (STATIONARITY_SKILL(1800) >= 0.05) AND (perm p < 0.05) AND (clustered CI lower > 0). Let INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT = at least one class in {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR} is present at T0 AND every present class in that set has CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.90; Let INTRINSIC_BREAK = (an intrinsic class is present at T0) AND NOT INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT. Let RATE_TRANSIENT = (STRESS_FALSE_ACCEPT > 0.10) OR (median TRANSIENT_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE is finite and < 1800) OR (a RATE_LIMIT_429 endpoint is present at T0 and CLASS_PERSISTENCE[RATE_LIMIT_429] < 0.90) OR (AMBIENT_RECOVERY_n > 0) OR (STRESS_ONSET_n > 0). Let STATE_CHANGE_EVIDENCE = (AMBIENT_RECOVERY_n > 0) OR (AMBIENT_ONSET_n > 0) OR (DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT(1800) > 0.10) OR (DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT(1800) > 0.10). MI power is a REPORTED DIAGNOSTIC (MI_POWER_OK at rho=1.0, POWER_AT_RHO90, POWER_AT_DELTA_SKILL) and is NOT a branch gate, so no branch depends on a non-significant negative. The frozen branches are S1_STATIONARY (STAT_SIG_SIGONLY AND INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT AND NOT RATE_TRANSIENT AND NOT STATE_CHANGE_EVIDENCE; DENYLIST_HORIZON == 1800 is then an implied reported consequence, not a gate), S0_NON_STATIONARY (INTRINSIC_BREAK OR (STATE_CHANGE_EVIDENCE AND no intrinsic class present at T0)), SM_CLASS_CONDITIONAL (INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT AND RATE_TRANSIENT), SIN_INCONCLUSIVE (otherwise), plus MEASUREMENT_INVALID only on prerequisite/control failure. Fresh branch_probe2.py (/tmp/opencode/phys380_cal/branch_probe2.py sha256 0ffb401058e11e76c56dbeabbafe1c8c3e54b49a672ca649879adaee10afdb4d) demonstrates all five reachable on the actual logic; see prereg.md section 6.3.

B_EXCHANGE.description: Mandated memory/constant null: a GLOBAL uniform shuffle of the lag-state labels B_delta across all 57 endpoints (10000 permutations, seed 38074818597), preserving the anchor marginals because only the lag labels are permuted, and recompute I(B_0;B_delta). Permutation clusters are NOT preserved; the endpoint-clustered bootstrap (not the permutation) accounts for registrable-domain dependence. The primary p-value is (1 + #{perm MI >= observed MI}) / (1 + 10000). This is exactly the null that the anchor state carries no information about the lag state beyond the marginal (the identity-transfer predictor equals the constant-marginal predictor).

B_CONSTANT_USABLE.description: No-denylist baseline: predict non-barrier for every endpoint at every lag. Reference predictor for the secondary DENYLIST_SKILL (log-loss improvement of the anchor-transfer predictor over always-usable).

B_MARGINAL.description: Predict the lag class from the lag-period marginal class frequency (constant marginal predictor).

B_LASTSWEEP.description: Memory/persistence baseline that predicts B_delta_k from the immediately preceding ladder observation B_delta_{k-1} rather than from the anchor B_0. Used only to report whether the most recent observation predicts the next better than the anchor (re-probe interval diagnostic).

baselines.comparison: The primary stationarity metric is measured against the B_EXCHANGE permutation null; DENYLIST_SKILL is measured against B_CONSTANT_USABLE.

PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.description: Offline planted-stationary generator: N=57 endpoints; anchor state Bernoulli(f_b); lag state equals the anchor state with probability rho (otherwise redrawn from Bernoulli(f_b)). The SAME plug-in MI estimator and B_EXCHANGE permutation test are applied. Fresh DESIGN-time calibration (non-outcome-bearing, no Web data) used R=200 replications, perms_per_rep=1000, seed 38074818597 (/tmp/opencode/phys380_cal/calib.py sha256 c5860b9b5fedd41e0356b4553e49b4fe16debef98a02104a809d4b367c03e886).
PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.power_requirement: Fraction of R replications with permutation p < 0.05 must be >= 0.80. Fresh achieved power: f_b=0.20,rho=0.80 -> 1.00; f_b=0.10,rho=0.80 -> 0.985. EXECUTE additionally reports, as non-gating diagnostics, MI_POWER_OK (power at f_b_obs, rho=1.0; fresh 0.955/0.990/0.995/1.00 at f_b=0.05/0.08/0.10/0.20), POWER_AT_RHO90 (fresh ~0.97) and POWER_AT_DELTA_SKILL (power at MI=0.05 nats; fresh ~0.49-0.67). Branch decisions do NOT depend on these diagnostics.
PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.construct_boundary: Validates that the estimator recovers a known stationary endpoint population at this sample size; it does not assert that any real endpoint is stationary. Boundary calibration: power=0.81 at f_b=0.10,rho=0.50 and only ~0.49-0.67 to detect MI=delta_SKILL=0.05 nats at N=57, both disclosed as the low-effect corners; the weak-effect underpowering is why S0 rests on positive change evidence instead of non-significance.

PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.description: Live positive control on non-pool hosts with deterministic status: https://httpbin.org/status/429 must classify RATE_LIMIT_429; a guaranteed-unresolvable host (https://no-such-host.invalid/) must classify TRANSPORT_ERROR; https://httpbin.org/status/403 must classify UNAVAILABLE_403 (proving the classifier separates 403-as-plain-unavailability from a challenge 403). A second 429 oracle host (https://httpbingo.org/status/429) is requested as a redundancy check, and if BOTH 429 oracle hosts are unreachable/challenged the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID rather than silently dropping the control. The BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE branch is exercised by natural pool endpoints (prerequisite floor >= 1 challenge endpoint at T0) and by the frozen classifier replay control, not by a synthetic oracle.
PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.pass_condition: Every oracle request is classified into its expected intrinsic class; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.construct_boundary: Confirms the live collection+classifier code path can register barriers and can distinguish 403-as-block from 403-as-plain; it is not a natural Web barrier.

NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.description: Offline exchangeable generator: N=57 endpoints; anchor and lag binary states are drawn independently with the same per-endpoint Bernoulli prevalence (no persistence). Fed through the SAME estimator and B_EXCHANGE permutation test. Fresh DESIGN-time calibration used R=200, perms_per_rep=1000, seed 38074818598 (/tmp/opencode/phys380_cal/calib.py).
NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.pass_condition: Fraction of R replications with permutation p < 0.05 must be <= 0.05; the fresh achieved false-positive rate is 0.01 at p=0.20 (0.03 at p=0.30).
NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.construct_boundary: Calibrates the null: a genuinely exchangeable endpoint population must not yield spurious stationarity skill.

NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.description: Live negative control on https://httpbin.org/status/200, https://httpbin.org/uuid and the redundant https://example.com/ , which must classify CLEAN.
NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.pass_condition: All requests classify CLEAN; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.construct_boundary: Confirms the classifier does not fire on clean responses.

C_PROBE_LOAD.description: Validity control for self-induction, NOT a statistical null: Cochran-Armitage trend of ambient barrier prevalence across the 5 sweep indices for the 52 non-stressed endpoints, plus the pre-freeze replica STATIONARITY_SKILL_NO_STRESS measured on the 52 non-stressed endpoints. Under no probe-induced drift the trend slope is ~0 and the no-stress skill matches the full-pool skill. A positive slope or a large full-vs-no-stress gap is reported as a self-induction caveat; it does not by itself invalidate the run but is disclosed next to every persistence estimate.
C_PROBE_LOAD.pass_condition: No hard pass/fail; reported transparently. If the slope CI excludes 0 with rising prevalence it is recorded as a validity threat to the STATIONARY branch.
C_PROBE_LOAD.construct_boundary: Separates genuine endpoint persistence from accumulation of barriers caused by our own single-GET probes.

measurement_validity.target_integrity: Every request stores raw HTTP status, response headers (server, cf-mitigated, retry-after), body SHA-256, byte length, first 20000 body bytes for marker matching, elapsed ms, sweep index, attempt index, endpoint and any transport error string. The intrinsic class is a pure deterministic function of those stored fields under the frozen classifier, so AUDIT can recompute it.
measurement_validity.label_determinism: Each sweep's ambient class depends only on that sweep's single response; the load class depends only on that burst's responses. No class depends on the anchor state, so conditioning on the anchor state does not leak the lag label.
measurement_validity.split_integrity: The anchor window is sweep 0; lag labels are sweeps 1..4 at target offsets 20/120/600/1800 s. There is no fitting: the estimator is a pre-registered closed-form mutual information; exactness is by permutation and clustered bootstrap, not cross-validation.
measurement_validity.uncertainty_integrity: Endpoint-permutation null: 10000 GLOBAL uniform shuffles of the lag vector across all 57 endpoints (seed 38074818597) for STATIONARITY_SKILL p-values. Endpoint-clustered bootstrap: cluster = registrable domain, where registrable_domain(url) is the frozen deterministic function 'take the URL host, strip a single leading www., and retain the final two dot-separated labels' (no multi-label public suffix occurs in the frozen 57); e.g. gitlab.gnome.org -> gnome.org, www.djangoproject.com -> djangoproject.com. 10000 resamples (seed 38074818597) give percentile 95% CIs of STATIONARITY_SKILL and of FA/FR at each lag.
measurement_validity.sampling_integrity: The 57-endpoint universe is frozen and may not be substituted, added to or dropped. Per-sweep endpoint probe ORDER is a frozen seeded permutation (seed 38074818597) so any residual load effect is not systematically associated with endpoint identity or sweep. No endpoint may be dropped after seeing its outcomes.
measurement_validity.representation_integrity: One stdlib-HTTP client, one User-Agent, one network egress vantage, one ~30-minute wall-clock window. The source-vantage axis of the mandate is NOT varied and is a declared scope boundary. Results describe this pool, this vantage and this window only.
measurement_validity.control_integrity: PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY power at the frozen f_b=0.20,rho=0.80 and NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE false-positive at p=0.20 must meet their frozen bounds; PC_ORACLE_BARRIER and NC_CLEAN_ORACLE live classifications must be correct; the classifier replay must yield 0 mismatches. Any failure => status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a scientific negative.
measurement_validity.prerequisite_integrity: Live network must reach the frozen universe and both oracle hosts. At T0 the number of ambient-barrier endpoints must be >= 3 (dynamic-range floor) and the anchor and delta_ref sweeps must both complete; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID (attainability failure), because the pre-freeze census shows this floor is achievable.
measurement_validity.power_integrity: Stationarity detection power is REPORTED, not gated, so no branch rests on a non-significant negative. EXECUTE reports POWER_AT_DELTA_SKILL = power of the frozen PC generator to detect the minimum meaningful effect MI = delta_SKILL (0.05 nats) at the observed f_b_obs, POWER_AT_RHO90 = power at (f_b_obs, rho=0.90), and MI_POWER_OK = power at (f_b_obs, rho=1.0). Fresh DESIGN-time values at N=57 (R=200, 1000 perms; /tmp/opencode/phys380_cal/power_min.py sha256 84074980a49b624d42fe873be80d83d4c53b5866671bc6ef7c8f3e3d96d5a056): power at MI=0.05 is ~0.49-0.67, i.e. weak-but-real persistence is NOT reliably detectable at this n, while power at rho=0.90/1.0 is ~0.97/1.00. This weak-effect underpowering is disclosed and is exactly why S0 is defined by POSITIVE change evidence rather than by non-significance of the MI test. The T0 ambient-barrier floor (>= 3) remains the identifiability prerequisite and any shortfall is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not S0.
measurement_validity.resolution_disclosure: The false-accept resolution is 1/n_denylisted; with the census-consistent n_denylisted ~= 6-9 the smallest non-zero FA is ~0.11-0.17, so tau_FA=0.10 means ANY observed recovery flags the pooled-denylist horizon as failed. This coarse but conservative resolution is disclosed and is exactly why the pooled-denylist horizon is a reported product quantity while the stationarity/intrinsic-persistence decision is made separately (see decision_rule.branch_precedence). CLASS_PERSISTENCE has resolution 1/n_intrinsic; with n_intrinsic ~= 5, the >= 0.90 threshold requires ALL 5 intrinsic endpoints to persist (4/5 = 0.80 fails), so the intrinsic persistence test is deliberately stringent and a single flaky intrinsic endpoint routes S1/SM to S0 or SIN; this is disclosed.
measurement_validity.activity_disclosure: The only pre-freeze activity is non-outcome-bearing: (i) a reachability census over a fixed 26-endpoint subset of the frozen 57, in two sweeps separated by 30 s, with a 6-GET/0.12 s burst on the 5 rate-limit-capable endpoints (/tmp/opencode/phys380_cal/census.py sha256 5050fdf28cfbf230a70492cae6514d10ba5fcf8405c6a8672557f5628bfd72e3); (ii) offline estimator calibration, minimum-meaningful-effect power calibration and branch probes on synthetic data only (/tmp/opencode/phys380_cal/calib.py sha256 c5860b9b5fedd41e0356b4553e49b4fe16debef98a02104a809d4b367c03e886; power_min.py sha256 84074980a49b624d42fe873be80d83d4c53b5866671bc6ef7c8f3e3d96d5a056; branch_probe2.py sha256 0ffb401058e11e76c56dbeabbafe1c8c3e54b49a672ca649879adaee10afdb4d). These establish attainability, classifier liveness, estimator calibration, power and branch reachability only; they are not part of the frozen measurement. Their summary is reproduced literally in prereg.md. EXECUTE must itself re-verify all attainability floors and all control calibrations from its own collected data (the /tmp artifacts are not a frozen interpretation dependency and may not be re-hashed).

frozen_intrinsic_classifier.match_scope: CHALLENGE_RE is applied to the first 20000 bytes of the response body decoded as latin-1 (lossless byte mapping). cf-mitigated is lowercased and compared to the string 'challenge'.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.CLEAN: HTTP status in {200,202} and body does not match CHALLENGE_RE.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE: HTTP status == 403 AND (lowercase(cf-mitigated) == 'challenge' OR body matches CHALLENGE_RE).
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.UNAVAILABLE_403: HTTP status == 403 without any challenge marker.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.TRANSPORT_ERROR: No HTTP response (DNS failure, connection refused, TLS failure, or timeout).
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.OTHER_NONBARRIER: Any other HTTP status (404, 500, redirect chains to error, etc.).
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.label_determinism: All classes are functions of a single request's stored fields only; none depends on prior requests, so conditioning on the anchor state is not label leakage.

frozen_universe.source: verbatim endpoints of EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068 (which inherited them verbatim from EXP-PHYSICS-37973239386); used unchanged. EXECUTE may not substitute, add to, or drop endpoints.

sweep_protocol.ambient_probe: For EVERY endpoint: a fresh cookie jar, then exactly one HTTP GET to the endpoint URL. Store raw fields; ambient_class = classifier output. Endpoints are probed sequentially in a per-sweep frozen seeded permutation order (seed 38074818597) with inter-endpoint gap 0.30 s.
sweep_protocol.load_probe: Immediately AFTER its ambient probe, each endpoint in stratum_stress additionally receives a burst of B_stress=8 GETs at gap 0.15 s inside a SEPARATE fresh cookie jar; load_class = argmax severity_rank over the 8 responses. The 52 non-stress endpoints receive no load probe.
sweep_protocol.sweep_state_definition: The PRIMARY state used for stationarity/denylist metrics is ambient_class. load_class is used only for the transient-class recovery diagnostic.
sweep_protocol.request_headers: One frozen User-Agent string and Accept header recorded in prereg.md; GET only; no authentication; no credentials; no JavaScript.
sweep_protocol.gap_after_probe: 0.30 s between consecutive endpoints within a sweep.
sweep_protocol.partial_ladder_rule: The ANALYSIS labels each sweep by its NOMINAL ladder rung (sweep k -> sweep_target_offsets_s[k]) and evaluates all per-rung metrics (FA/FR, DENYLIST_HORIZON, DENYLIST_FIRST_FAIL_LAG) on those nominal rungs, so DENYLIST_HORIZON takes values in {0,20,120,600,1800}. The ACTUAL elapsed delta of each sweep is recorded and reported alongside the nominal rung and is used only for descriptive timing and for the delta_ref validity check. delta_ref is the final sweep (nominal 1800 s); its ACTUAL delta must be >= 1500 s or the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID. If the anchor (sweep 0) fails entirely, the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

request_policy.note: A single request defines an observation; there is NO retry, so a DNS/connect/TLS/timeout failure is directly TRANSPORT_ERROR rather than a retried CLEAN. The stored attempt_index is therefore 0 for ambient and load observations; the per_host_requests=2 for oracle controls are two independent observations, not retries.

stratum_stress.definition: Fixed pre-registered rate-limit-capable set derived from parent accepted evidence and the pre-freeze census; it is NOT selected from this run's outcomes.

stratum_intrinsic_candidates.definition: Fixed pre-registered towards-persistent-barrier candidates from parent accepted evidence plus the census; reported as a diagnostic subgroup, NOT selected from this run's outcomes.

strata.primary_inference_population: The full frozen 57-endpoint pool for STATIONARITY_SKILL and FA/FR; STATIONARITY_SKILL_NO_STRESS on the 52 non-stressed endpoints is a pre-registered robustness replica; class-conditional persistence uses the T0 ambient class of each endpoint.

decision_rule.metric_definition: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta) = plug-in binary mutual information I(B_anchor ; B_delta), in nats per endpoint, over the ambient barrier indicator (barrier_set vs non-barrier); B_EXCHANGE endpoint-permutation p-value (10000 permutations); endpoint-clustered bootstrap 95% CI [LO,HI] (10000 resamples). Higher = more stationary/identity-informative.

primary_decision_quantities.STAT_SIG_SIGONLY: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref) >= 0.05 AND perm p < 0.05 AND clustered CI lower > 0. (Stationarity evidence.)
primary_decision_quantities.MI_POWER_OK: power of PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY at (f_b=f_b_obs, rho=1.0, R=200, perms=1000) >= 0.80. REPORTED only; NOT a branch gate.
primary_decision_quantities.INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT: at least one class in {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR} is present at T0 AND every present class in that set has CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.90.
primary_decision_quantities.RATE_TRANSIENT: (STRESS_FALSE_ACCEPT > 0.10) OR (median TRANSIENT_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE finite and < 1800) OR (a RATE_LIMIT_429 endpoint is present at T0 and CLASS_PERSISTENCE[RATE_LIMIT_429] < 0.90) OR (AMBIENT_RECOVERY_n > 0) OR (STRESS_ONSET_n > 0). AMBIENT_RECOVERY_n counts ambient barrier->non-barrier transitions across consecutive ladder sweeps; STRESS_ONSET_n counts ambient RATE_LIMIT_429 appearances on stratum_stress endpoints whose T0 ambient class was not RATE_LIMIT_429. Generic ambient onsets are deliberately NOT part of this gate (they are reported as AMBIENT_ONSET_n but may be intrinsic).
primary_decision_quantities.DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT: FA(delta) = fraction of endpoints with an ambient barrier at T0 whose ambient class at delta is non-barrier (false-accept: denylisted endpoint recovered).
primary_decision_quantities.DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT: FR(delta) = fraction of endpoints ambient-non-barrier at T0 whose ambient class at delta is a barrier (false-reject: previously CLEAN endpoint newly blocks).
primary_decision_quantities.DENYLIST_HORIZON: largest ladder delta delta_k such that FA(delta_j) <= 0.10 AND FR(delta_j) <= 0.10 for ALL j <= k (a CONTIGUOUS VALID PREFIX from the first lag, so a mid-ladder failure cannot be masked by a later pass); 0 if the first lag already fails.
primary_decision_quantities.DENYLIST_FIRST_FAIL_LAG: smallest ladder delta at which FA > 0.10 or FR > 0.10, else null when the whole ladder passes.
primary_decision_quantities.INTRINSIC_BREAK: (an intrinsic class in {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR} is present at T0) AND NOT INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT.

secondary_quantities.STATIONARITY_SKILL_MULTI: plug-in 6-class mutual information I(C_anchor;C_delta) at delta_ref with the same permutation null.
secondary_quantities.STATIONARITY_SKILL_NO_STRESS: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref) restricted to the 52 non-stressed endpoints (self-induction robustness replica).
secondary_quantities.DENYLIST_SKILL: log-loss improvement (nats/endpoint) of the anchor-transfer predictor over B_CONSTANT_USABLE at delta_ref.
secondary_quantities.CLASS_PERSISTENCE: For each intrinsic class, the fraction of endpoints with that T0 ambient class whose delta_ref ambient class is identical.
secondary_quantities.TRANSIENT_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE: For stratum_stress endpoints, the smallest NOMINAL ladder rung at which the ambient class is non-barrier after a T0 load_class in barrier_set; report per-endpoint and median. If no stratum_stress endpoint has a T0 load_class in barrier_set, the median is null and the corresponding RATE_TRANSIENT term is false.
secondary_quantities.STRESS_FALSE_ACCEPT: fraction of stratum_stress endpoints with T0 load_class in barrier_set that are ambient-non-barrier at the delta_ref sweep. Defined as 0.0 when no stratum_stress endpoint has a T0 load_class in barrier_set (the condition is not triggered).
secondary_quantities.C_PROBE_LOAD: Cochran-Armitage trend of ambient barrier prevalence across sweeps for the 52 non-stress endpoints (slope, two-sided p).
secondary_quantities.AMBIENT_ONSET_n / AMBIENT_RECOVERY_n / P: AMBIENT_ONSET_n = number of consecutive-sweep non-barrier->barrier ambient transitions (over all endpoints, sweeps 0->1,1->2,2->3,3->4). AMBIENT_RECOVERY_n = number of consecutive-sweep barrier->non-barrier ambient transitions. PERSIST_n = number of endpoints whose ambient class is identical at T0 (sweep 0) and at the delta_ref sweep. STRESS_ONSET_n = number of ambient RATE_LIMIT_429 appearances on stratum_stress endpoints (any sweep) whose T0 ambient class was not RATE_LIMIT_429.
secondary_quantities.POWER_AT_DELTA_SKILL: power of the frozen PC generator to detect MI = delta_SKILL (0.05 nats) at the observed f_b_obs (reported diagnostic).
secondary_quantities.POWER_AT_RHO90: power of the frozen PC generator at (f_b_obs, rho=0.90) (reported diagnostic).

branch_precedence: 1. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any measurement_validity prerequisite fails (network unreachable to universe or oracle hosts; classifier replay mismatches > 0; PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY power at frozen f_b=0.20,rho=0.80 < 0.80; NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE false-positive > 0.05; PC_ORACLE_BARRIER or NC_CLEAN_ORACLE misclassified; fewer than 3 T0 ambient-barrier endpoints; anchor incomplete or delta_ref actual delta < 1500 s).

2. S0_NON_STATIONARY if INTRINSIC_BREAK OR (STATE_CHANGE_EVIDENCE AND no intrinsic class in {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR} is present at T0). This is a POSITIVE non-stationarity result (an intrinsic barrier class failed to persist, or the state changed with no intrinsic class to anchor it).

3. S1_STATIONARY if STAT_SIG_SIGONLY AND INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT AND NOT RATE_TRANSIENT AND NOT STATE_CHANGE_EVIDENCE. Under NOT STATE_CHANGE_EVIDENCE there are no ambient transitions and FA/FR <= 0.10 at the delta_ref rung, which IMPLIES the full nominal horizon (DENYLIST_HORIZON == 1800) as a REPORTED consequence rather than a branch gate; the pooled horizon can therefore never by itself flip the branch.

5. SIN_INCONCLUSIVE otherwise (notably: INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT AND NOT RATE_TRANSIENT with a non-rate state change; no intrinsic class at T0 and no state change; or any configuration where neither stationarity nor positive change is established). A non-significant STAT_SIG_SIGONLY with no positive change evidence is SIN_INCONCLUSIVE, NEVER S0.
decision_rule.measurement_invalid_conditions: Network unreachable to the frozen universe or oracle hosts; classifier not reproducible from stored raw fields; PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY power < 0.80 at the frozen f_b=0.20,rho=0.80; NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE false-positive > 0.05; PC_ORACLE_BARRIER or NC_CLEAN_ORACLE misclassified; fewer than 3 T0 ambient-barrier endpoints; anchor incomplete or delta_ref actual delta < 1500 s. These are attainability/measurement failures and MUST NOT be reported as S0_NON_STATIONARY.
decision_rule.claim_ceiling: At most C-WEB-DYNAMICS = HYPOTHESIS here; H2/S0 and H2b/SM bound (do not reject) a pooled static-denylist prior on this frozen pool/window. No PRODUCT_CORE promotion and no EXPERIMENTAL upgrade from this single window ladder.

product_consequence_positive: If S1_STATIONARY: a static endpoint-level denylist built from one observation window remains valid through the longest tested lag (1800 s) on this pool, so the dead-end policy can adopt a long, quantifiable re-probe interval and terminal classification for denylisted endpoints, and does not need an online per-endpoint history model for access decisions. The measured DENYLIST_HORIZON becomes the schedulable re-probe interval. If SM_CLASS_CONDITIONAL: the intrinsic-block track (BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR) keeps a long horizon and the rate-driven track uses the measured TRANSIENT_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE, so POLICY_CLASS_CONDITIONAL_DENYLIST is licensed; this is a positive, product-usable, bounded result even though it is not a uniform static denylist.
product_consequence_negative: If S0_NON_STATIONARY: endpoint access state is non-amortizable on this pool; the product must re-observe before each use and must not cache a static per-endpoint access decision. If SIN_INCONCLUSIVE: no policy change is licensed; the pooled-denylist validity horizon remains unmeasured on this pool/window and the dead-end policy must keep its current re-probe behaviour. Both bound (do not close) the timescale axis of C-WEB-DYNAMICS on this pool/window.

estimated_cost.http_requests_breakdown: 5 sweeps x (57 ambient GETs + 5 stratum_stress x 8 load GETs) = 5 x 97 = 485, plus ~12 oracle GETs; transient retries bounded by the worst-case cap

expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing. This is the first falsification-first measurement on the frozen credential-free pool of ENDPOINT access-state persistence across separated windows rather than next-request classification, and it produces the two quantities the product's dead-end policy currently assumes: DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT/FALSE_REJECT curves with a DENYLIST_HORIZON, plus class-conditional persistence/half-lives. Either branch is decision-relevant (uniform static horizon vs class-conditional/short horizon vs no static amortization), and the redesigned branch precedence makes S0 a POSITIVE change result and keeps the primary stationarity conclusion independent of both the coarse pooled-denylist resolution and a possibly underpowered MI test, so a class-conditional world is correctly reported as SM and an ambiguous negative as SIN rather than falsely as S0. It bounds or advances the timescale axis of C-WEB-DYNAMICS without repeating the exhausted next-request or value-derivation sub-threads.

No LLM calls, no browser, no credentials.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: All five dispositions are reachable through the frozen metric, and the fresh design-time branch probe (/tmp/opencode/phys380_cal/branch_probe2.py sha256 0ffb401058e11e76c56dbeabbafe1c8c3e54b49a672ca649879adaee10afdb4d) produced them on the actual plug-in MI + B_EXCHANGE permutation + intrinsic-persistence + rate-transient + state-change logic (no Web data). S1_STATIONARY: a stationary plant (6 persistent BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE + 1 persistent TRANSPORT_ERROR over the nominal ladder) gave STATIONARITY_SKILL=0.3725, perm p=0.002 (STAT_SIG_SIGONLY true), INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT true, NOT RATE_TRANSIENT, no state change; the full nominal horizon is implied. S0_NON_STATIONARY: an exchangeable plant (Bernoulli 0.15 barrier per sweep; >= 3 T0 barriers so the floor is met) gave MI=0.0075, p=0.573, INTRINSIC_BREAK true, FA=0.714 -> S0 by POSITIVE change evidence, not by non-significance. SM_CLASS_CONDITIONAL: 6 persistent intrinsic + 3 RATE_LIMIT_429 endpoints that recover gave MI=0.2360, p=0.002, INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT true, RATE_TRANSIENT true, FA=0.333. SIN_INCONCLUSIVE: a floor-satisfying pool with 6 persistent intrinsic barriers plus a single non-rate generic onset gave MI=0.2861, p=0.002, INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT true, NOT RATE_TRANSIENT, STATE_CHANGE_EVIDENCE true -> SIN. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is produced only by prerequisite/control failure (including fewer than 3 T0 ambient-barrier endpoints), never by a scientific outcome. The decision is decoupled from MI non-significance (S0 requires positive change) and from the pooled horizon (S1 does not gate on DENYLIST_HORIZON; the horizon is an implied reported consequence), so a class-conditional world is SM and an ambiguous negative is SIN.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: The frozen 57-endpoint universe and both oracle host groups are live-reachable from this environment in the pre-freeze census (/tmp/opencode/phys380_cal/census.py, sha256 5050fdf28cfbf230a70492cae6514d10ba5fcf8405c6a8672557f5628bfd72e3). Over a fixed 26-endpoint subset in two sweeps separated by 30 s, the frozen classifier observed: window-A class histogram {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE 5, TRANSPORT_ERROR 1, RATE_LIMIT_429 1, OTHER_NONBARRIER 2, CLEAN 17}; 6 stably persistent barrier endpoints across both census runs (gitlab.com/users/sign_in, community.cloudflare.com, www.npmjs.com/login, wordpress.com/log-in, www.phpbb.com/community/, community.invisioncommunity.com); a live recovery of a rate-limited endpoint in one run (search.brave.com/search?q=test RATE_LIMIT_429 -> CLEAN across a 30 s pair) and the same endpoint persisting in a second run (run-to-run variability of the rate class, exactly the class-conditional structure the experiment measures); live RATE_LIMIT_429 onsets under the 6-GET burst on www.djangoproject.com/accounts/login/ and search.brave.com; and oracle liveness (httpbin 429/403/200/uuid and no-such-host.invalid all classified as expected; oracle_ok=true). The classifier is deterministic from stored fields, so reproducibility is checkable. EXECUTE must re-verify network reachability, oracle classifications, the >= 3 T0 ambient-barrier floor and both frozen control calibrations before interpreting collection; failure yields MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The primary null is non-degenerate and the metric separates the two regimes rather than sitting at a ceiling. Fresh design-time calibration on the actual plug-in MI + B_EXCHANGE permutation statistic (no Web data; /tmp/opencode/phys380_cal/calib.py) gave: NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE false-positive 0.01 at p=0.20 and 0.03 at p=0.30 (<= 0.05), so exchangeable endpoints do NOT produce spurious stationarity skill; PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY power 1.00 at f_b=0.20,rho=0.80 and 0.985 at f_b=0.10,rho=0.80 (>= 0.80), so a genuinely stationary population is detected. B_CONSTANT_USABLE is a distinct floor from B_EXCHANGE: the identity-transfer predictor beats the constant-usable prior only when the anchor is informative (MI > 0), and the census shows the anchor is informative (6 persistent barriers, ~27% barrier prevalence on the census subset). Power is reported as a diagnostic (POWER_AT_DELTA_SKILL ~0.49-0.67, POWER_AT_RHO90 ~0.97 at N=57) and is deliberately NOT a branch gate; S0 rests on positive change evidence, so low power for weak effects cannot manufacture an S0 and cannot manufacture an S1.

control_sensitivity.reason: Two disjoint synthetic controls bracket the estimator with demonstrated, not asserted, sensitivity: PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY requires >= 0.80 power to recover a planted stationary population (fresh achieved 1.00 at f_b=0.20,rho=0.80) and NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE requires <= 0.05 false-positive on exchangeable data (fresh achieved 0.01). Two live controls validate the real code path in the census: PC_ORACLE_BARRIER classified httpbin 429 as RATE_LIMIT_429, no-such-host.invalid as TRANSPORT_ERROR and httpbin 403 as UNAVAILABLE_403, while NC_CLEAN_ORACLE classified httpbin 200/uuid as CLEAN (oracle_ok=true). C_PROBE_LOAD adds a self-induction trend control plus the pre-registered STATIONARITY_SKILL_NO_STRESS replica. Both positive and negative sensitivity are therefore demonstrated synthetically and live.

treatment_liveness.reason: This is a Physics measurement/estimation experiment on a real Web substrate, not a Product inheritance/residual-novelty/LLM-inheritance/product-economics experiment and it contains no SPIDER treatment arm. The packet's treatment-liveness requirement is explicitly Product-scoped, so it does not apply. The live contrast that matters here is the estimator's own comparator, and it is realized and reachable: the anchor-state transfer predictor is compared against B_EXCHANGE (permutation null, calibrated FP 0.01), B_CONSTANT_USABLE (floor) and B_MARGINAL; the estimable decision object POLICY_STATIC_DENYLIST is a bounded deterministic function of ambient_class (DENY if in barrier_set else ALLOW) that returns a defined decision for every class and always terminates, and POLICY_CLASS_CONDITIONAL_DENYLIST is defined whenever the SM branch is reached. No treatment is structurally incapable of becoming EXECUTABLE because no treatment exists.
